    BufferedReader br;
    StringTokenizer st;
    PrintWriter out;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        new TaskD().run();
    }

    public String nextToken() {
        while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            try {
                st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                eof = true;
                return "-1";
            }
        }
        return st.nextToken();
    }

    public int nextInt() {
        return Integer.parseInt(nextToken());
    }

    public long nextLong() {
        return Long.parseLong(nextToken());
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return Double.parseDouble(nextToken());
    }

    String nextLine() throws IOException {
        return br.readLine();
    }

    void run() throws IOException {
        File f = new File("a.in");
        InputStream input = System.in;
        PrintStream output = System.out;
        if (f.exists() && f.canRead()) {
            input = new FileInputStream(f);
            output = new PrintStream("a.out");
        }
        br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(input));
        out = new PrintWriter(output);
        solve();
        br.close();
        out.close();
    }

    void solve() {
        long n = nextLong(), m = nextLong();
        if (n > m) {
            long tmp = n;
            n = m;
            m = tmp;
        }
        if (n > 3) {
            long total = n * m;
            out.println(total - (total % 2));
        } else {
            long s = m - (m % 6);
            long h = 0;
            long remainder = m % 6;
            if (n == 1) {
                if (remainder == 4) h = 2;
                else if (remainder == 5) h = 4;
            } else if (n == 2) {
                if (remainder == 3) h = 4;
                else if (remainder == 4) h = 8;
                else if (remainder == 5) h = 10;
            } else if (n == 3) {
                if (remainder == 2) h = 4;
                else if (remainder == 3) h = 8;
                else if (remainder == 4) h = 12;
                else if (remainder == 5) h = 14;
            }
            if (n + m > 9 && n > 1) {
                long total = n * m;
                out.println(total - (total % 2));
                return;
            }
            out.println(s * n + h);
        }
    }
}
